description: This Java source file implements an immutable class NullFeatureDefinition which represents a null or empty feature definition within a model. It provides methods to access identifiers, size, stream, and JSON representation relevant to this null object implementation.

classes.name: NullFeatureDefinition
classes.description: An immutable singleton implementation of FeatureDefinition representing a null or empty feature, providing methods to access identifiers and JSON serialization.

classes.name: NullFeatureDefinition.NullIdentifier
classes.description: A private static class implementing DefinitionIdentifier, representing a null identifier with empty string attributes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to obtain an instance of NullFeatureDefinition implementing FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a NullIdentifier, representing the first or only identifier in this null feature.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating an empty feature definition.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty Stream of DefinitionIdentifier.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over an empty list of identifiers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JsonArray representing a null or empty array as provided by JsonFactory.nullArray().

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the wrapped JsonArray.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on the wrapped JsonArray.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NullFeatureDefinition instance.
